role: CI guard (make sbom-guard; ci.yml 'SBOM drift' step; gates.yml) that the hand-maintained `packages` array in AcknowledgementsView (PrivacyPolicyView.swift) mirrors the SPM Package.resolved pins one-to-one with equal versions.
toplevel: cd to repo root; exit 2 if Package.resolved or PrivacyPolicyView.swift missing. Embedded python: loads pins (exit 2 on OSError/JSONDecodeError), maps identity.lower() -> state.version (pins with empty identity skipped; branch/revision pins get version ''). Regex `Pkg\(\s*name:\s*".."\s*,\s*version:\s*".."` over the Swift source, keys lowercased; zero matches -> exit 2 ('view shape changed'). Computes missing (resolved-declared), extra (declared-resolved), mismatched (both present and resolved version non-empty and differs; a revision-only pin is never version-checked). Prints a FAIL block per non-empty set and exits 1; else prints 'clean' with pin count and exits 0. Verified at 8d32097: 11 pins, 11 Pkg entries, all versions equal. Only the iOS project's Package.resolved is read; the regex scans the whole file so a Pkg(...) literal anywhere else in PrivacyPolicyView.swift would also count. The units listed for lines 93/100/107 are `print()` calls inside the heredoc, not functions.
